tests.summary: Run the repository software-only validation baseline.
Check the exact FCU3 application and selected feature set.
Check the exact Foxeer application and selected feature set.
Establish common boot, idle, and actuator-inhibit behavior without actuator power.
stop_conditions: unexpected motor output or actuator activity
boot, panic, health, or arming state cannot be observed
exact target or feature set is unknown

tests.summary: Validate Foxeer disarmed USB RC configuration and restore the reviewed baseline.
stop_conditions: the exact image, features, propeller state, or actuator-power state is unknown
the target arms, produces actuator activity, or requires actuator power
invalid values are accepted or valid values cannot be saved and applied without reboot
the temporary profile does not persist across cold boot or the reviewed baseline cannot be restored
evidence: commit or working-tree identity and firmware image hash
exact feature set and power/propeller state
invalid-value rejection and same-boot temporary configuration
restored baseline before and after cold boot

tests.summary: Run the FCU3 powered props-off exact-flight-image DShot gate.
stop_conditions: propellers are installed
unexpected motor identity, direction, command, or arming behavior
DShot transport fault, RC loss, stale command, smoke, heat, or rough motor sound
evidence: commit or working-tree identity, exact features, and candidate ELF hash
matching logger ELF hash and retained RTT log
FCU3 board and IMU identity with power and propeller state
unpowered DShot counters and mapping evidence when required
arming, eRPM, telemetry, disarming, and RC-loss evidence
stick direction, rate limit, and correction-opposition observations

tests.summary: Run the Foxeer powered props-off exact-flight-image gate.
stop_conditions: propellers are installed
physical and controller axis signs do not match the reviewed convention
unexpected motor identity, direction, command, or arming behavior
transport fault, RC loss, smoke, heat, or rough motor sound
evidence: commit or working-tree identity, firmware image hash, and exact feature set
arming, disarming, RC-loss, DShot, and telemetry evidence
motor identity, RC direction and limit, and correction-opposition observations
selected onboard flight and log identity

tests.summary: Run the final FCU3 exact-image preflight gate.
stop_conditions: the exact image, features, configuration, or matching logger ELF is unknown
motor identity, gyro signs, tilt correction, arming, disarm, or RC-loss behavior is not confirmed
smoke, heat, abnormal current, vibration, or reinforcing correction is observed
evidence: commit or working-tree identity, candidate and logger ELF hashes, and exact features

tests.summary: Run the final Foxeer exact-image preflight gate.
stop_conditions: the exact image, persisted configuration, feature set, or flight-log state is unknown
motor opposition, RC direction, arming, disarm, or RC-loss behavior is not confirmed props-off
withdrawn gains or a pre-fix image is selected
smoke, heat, abnormal current, vibration, or reinforcing correction is observed
evidence: commit or working-tree identity, firmware image hash, and exact features
planned flight ID and available onboard-log capacity

tests.summary: Run one bounded logged FCU3 characterization flight.
stop_conditions: any preflight prerequisite is incomplete or needs review
wrong motor or stick response
roll, pitch, or yaw runaway
hard oscillation, smoke, heat, rough motor sound, abnormal current, or loss of control confidence
evidence: candidate and matching logger ELF hashes, exact features, and runtime tuning
retained RTT flight log and SHA-256
command tracking, oscillation, mixer headroom, and controller-boundary review

tests.summary: Run one conservative logged Foxeer characterization hop.
stop_conditions: any preflight prerequisite is incomplete or needs review
wrong motor, stick, or tilt-correction response
roll, pitch, or yaw runaway
hard oscillation, smoke, heat, rough motor sound, abnormal current, or loss of control confidence
evidence: firmware image hash, exact features, and persisted configuration
selected onboard flight ID and CRC-validated downloaded log with SHA-256
command tracking, oscillation, mixer headroom, and arm-boundary review
